schema_objects.media_asset_jobs:
CREATE TABLE media_asset_jobs (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lease_token VARCHAR(32), 
	lease_at DATETIME, 
	output JSON, 
	adoption JSON, 
	error_code VARCHAR(40), 
	message VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_media_asset_job_request UNIQUE (owner_id, request_id)
)
schema_objects.media_asset_profiles:
CREATE TABLE media_asset_profiles (
	owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	settings JSON NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (owner_id, customer_id)
)
schema_objects.media_asset_requests:
CREATE TABLE media_asset_requests (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_media_asset_request UNIQUE (owner_id, request_id)
)
